title: Schlag gegen mutmaßliche kriminelle Vereinigung – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse und Haftbefehle vollstreckt sowie Vermögenswerte in Millionenhöhe gesichert

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors raided 16 properties in Berlin and Brandenburg against four suspects accused of money laundering through a network of front companies and bank accounts. Around 2 million euros were secured, and a firearm, gold, cash and a Lamborghini were seized.
